mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate indicates an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 214.268, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP growth and housing starts indicate broad economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising interest rates above 5.0% signal active monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
